label: SCG I.22 contingent adjunct is not first esse bearer's quiddity
paraphrase: At a selected world, assuming three OPEN interpretation principles, any x whose esse principle e is necessary throughout the selected accessibility cone and which is ontically identified with that e cannot have as its genuine quiddity the separately proposed q whose conjunction to e is contingent. This does not deny x's actual q.3 essence: a rejected proposal is not that essence by fiat. Conditional interpretation of SCG I.22 nn.3–4, not an unconditional D-to-E inference, and not the claim that e and q must be identical.
